configurePresets.name: win-ninja
configurePresets.description: Does not use the Visual Studio IDE generator. Needs ninja.exe in PATH. Use a VS Developer PowerShell/Command Prompt for MSVC, or a shell where the compiler is on PATH.

configurePresets.name: win-ninja-vcpkg
configurePresets.displayName: Windows — Ninja + vcpkg (use if VS install not found)
configurePresets.description: Same as win-ninja, plus the vcpkg manifest toolchain from VCPKG_ROOT. Recommended on Windows with vcpkg when cmake reports it cannot find a Visual Studio instance for the Visual Studio generator.

configurePresets.name: win-vs
configurePresets.description: Avoids the NMake generator. Requires a Visual Studio instance CMake can detect. If you see an error that no instance of Visual Studio was found, use win-ninja or win-ninja-vcpkg instead.

configurePresets.name: win-vs-vcpkg
configurePresets.description: Same as win-vs, plus CMAKE_TOOLCHAIN_FILE from the VCPKG_ROOT environment variable.

buildPresets.name: win-release
buildPresets.description: For Visual Studio generators only. Passes --config Release.
